the potential influence of the US higher education system, and its international students, on the development of the UK’s higher education sector.
the extent to which the USA is a ‘role model’ for the UK in relation to the provision of support for students, particularly international students.
the extent to which the USA HE system might be influencing the UK HE system in terms of the provision of support for international and other students.

whilst there is evidence to suggest a ‘special relationship’ between the UK and USA, it does not appear to be a one-way process.
